spans.s: AF0733 दुष्ट duṣṭa Vitiated; Turbid, Fetid, Bad
AT0106 दुष्ट जल duṣṭa jala Poisoned /polluted water.

AT0105 दूषीविषम् dūṣīviṣam chronic poisoning/Either inanimate, animate or artificial poison when it becomes less potent after its treatment and when its effects are not nullified radically, because of which it resides in the body that particular less potent part of the above said poison is called dushivisha.
SK0072 दूष्य dūṣya Any bodily structure that gets vitiated by aggravated Doṣas
